newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Royale Belge sees 12 pct ROE in yrs ahead.
newsitem.headline: Royale Belge sees 12 pct ROE in yrs ahead.

text.p: Belgian insurer Royale Belge said in its annual report it was confident of achieving a return on equity in excess of 12 percent "for the years to come".

It said this forecast was based on the strong market position of the group's various units and the "quality" of its 1996 results. Royale Belge's 1996 profit rose to 11.3 from 6.6 billion Belgian francs, thanks in part to a 4.2 billion franc capital gain on the sale of shares in utility Tractebel.
It said its ROE was 12.6 percent.

Royale Belge is due to hold its annual general meeting on May 28 at which its main shareholder, French insurance group AXA-UAP, is expected to say whether it intends to merge the company with AXA Belgium.
